messages:
Liam (AE): Procurement at Bayline needs compliance artifacts to approve the POC: redacted SOC2, ISO scope, pen-test attestation, and a short Dedicated pricing estimate. Who can own?
Ava (Solutions): I can. Confirm redacted SOC2 OK?
Liam (AE): They said procurement needs something "official" but not raw findings. Redacted should work.
Diego (Infosec): Standard: redacted SOC2 summary + ISO scope. For pen-test we provide a signed attestation from our vendor listing scope and date. No vulnerability details without NDA.
Rhea (Legal): I will draft the pen-test attestation with limited wording (scope/date/confirm test performed). Will avoid technical vuln info.
EvidenceBot: Created request EB-2024-1499. S3 path: s3://redwood-evidence/handovers/EB-2024-1499/
Ava (Solutions): Plan to assemble files: SOC2-summary.pdf, ISO-scope.pdf, pen-test-attestation.pdf, pricing-estimate.txt. Will include staging README with test creds and note that KMS keys are not shared.
Liam (AE): They want it within 48 hours to keep the POC timeline.
Diego (Infosec): We can deliver in 48h if Legal signs today. Also include last external scan date. EvidenceBot, what's the last external scan?
EvidenceBot: Last external scan: 2024-11-03. Summary at s3://redwood-evidence/scans/2024-11-03-external-summary.pdf
Rhea (Legal): Draft uploaded to drive:/Legal/PenTests/Bayline_attestation_v1.docx. Will notify when signed.
Ava (Solutions): SFTP drop details: sftp.redwood-infra.com:/incoming/bayline-2415554321. Example: `put EB-2024-1499.tar.gz`
Liam (AE): Also asking if Dedicated during POC affects SLA/pricing. Keep answer high-level.
Ava (Solutions): I'll include: "Estimated POC dedicated pricing: ~$450/day (varies by GPU & hours). SLA conceptually same; contract terms apply."
Diego (Infosec): If they require raw finding detail, escalate to Compliance — that will push timeline to >10 business days.
Liam (AE): Got it. I'll chase NDA signature.
EvidenceBot: EB-2024-1499 assigned to Ava. Status: open.
